alibabacloud-pai-quota-management v0.0.1 – Initial Release

- Introduces full lifecycle management for Alibaba Cloud PAI Quotas via the aliyun CLI (`paistudio` and `aiworkspace` plugins).
- Supports creating, scaling, updating, deleting quotas; managing root/child quota trees; binding/detaching quotas to/from workspaces.
- Enforces strict confirmation workflows: critical operations (create, update, scale, delete, detach) require a two-step process with dry-run and explicit user confirmation.
- All business API calls must include detailed per-session user-agent flags for observability.
- Documents required permissions, environment variables, and parameter sourcing rules.
- No direct handling of secret credentials; follows best-practice Alibaba Cloud CLI and RAM permissions security models.
